what_it_is.prose: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Ltd is a Mumbai-based Indian private-sector defence and space engineering company, founded in 1979. It is a progressive Tier-2 defence engineering company in India delivering state-of-the-art optronics and space solutions. Paras is the exclusive optics supplier to the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) and supplies high-precision defence and space optics for India's strategic programmes including ISRO, DRDO and the Indian Armed Forces. Product portfolio: defence and space optics, defence electronics, EMP (electromagnetic pulse) shielding solutions, heavy engineering, and turnkey projects. Subsidiary Paras Anti-Drone Technologies Pvt Ltd (Navi Mumbai) develops counter-UAS technology — products include Manpack Drone Detector with Handheld Drone Jammer, integrated anti-drone systems with drone jammers. Recent contracts: ₹46.19 crore anti-drone system contract (drone jammers); Powerus Guardian-1 high-speed counter-drone system — exclusive India manufacturing rights (partnership with US-based Powerus, July 2026); partnership with France-based CERBAIR for counter-UAV technology (July 2025). Paras is also in the process of offering turnkey laser-based air defence solutions against hostile drones and aerial targets.
